versions.changelog: Update model skills (names/params refreshed); add search-audio/image/video

- Bumped version to 1.1.1.
- Documentation updated in SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md; no feature or command changes.

- Adds support for `dlazy login` device-code authentication for easier API key setup.
- Updates authentication instructions to recommend `dlazy login` over manual API key entry.
- Clarifies manual API key workflow as an alternative to device-code login.
- Updates output sample `modelId` value for accuracy.
Sync to CLI 1.0.9 with cliWarning support

Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Updated version to 1.0.2
- Adjusted agent instructions: clarified API key handling—users are now prompted to send their key, which is then saved before resuming tasks.
- Minor clarification in error handling documentation regarding user interactions.
- No functional or command-line changes were introduced.

- Added an "Authentication" section with instructions for obtaining and configuring the dLazy API key.
- Clarified that all requests require CLI authentication with a user API key.
- Updated required CLI version for install instructions from @dlazy/cli@1.0.5 to @dlazy/cli@1.0.6.
- Minor documentation and formatting enhancements in usage instructions.

- Initial release of dlazy-wan2.6-r2v (v1.0.0).
- Enables accurate continuous video generation from reference images using the Wan 2.6 R2V model.
- Provides command-line options for prompt, image input (up to 10), size, duration, shot type, watermark, and advanced controls.
- Includes clear error handling instructions and agent prompts for missing API key or insufficient credits.
- Output returns a video URL upon success.
